## 更新内容 / Changes

- Claude 会话接入统一会话管理：浏览默认 Claude Code 目录、受管 CLI 实例与 Claude Desktop 已保存的本地 Code 历史，按客户端、来源、项目、标题 / ID 和正文筛选；分页阅读对话、思考和工具记录。
- 停止的受管 Claude CLI 实例支持“恢复会话”：先预览来源实例、账号、模型和原项目，再通过该实例的正常启动流程继续。恢复前复核文件、目录、账号绑定及同 ID 冲突，临时恢复参数不会改写实例设置。运行中的实例保持原终端。
- 默认目录及 Desktop 本地 Code 记录只读；Chat、Cowork、SSH 和云端历史及继续 Desktop 对话仍在原客户端中管理。工具参数限制深度、条目及文本大小，附件不自动展开，正文以文本显示。
- 修正 Sub2API 额度查询的自动探测：已识别供应商优先请求其版本化额度接口，OpenAI 与 Anthropic Messages 密钥各自使用自己的凭据查询。保留旧路径、租户前缀和缺失后的回退；详情区分超时、网络 / 代理问题及服务端拒绝。

- Claude history is available on the shared Sessions page: browse the default Claude Code directory, managed CLI instances and locally saved Claude Desktop Code transcripts. Filter by client, source, project, title / ID and content, and read paginated messages, thinking and tool records.
- Resume a stopped managed Claude CLI instance after reviewing its instance, account, model and original project. The normal instance launcher rechecks the transcript, directories, account binding and duplicate IDs before starting. Temporary resume arguments do not change saved instance settings. Running instances keep their existing terminal.
- Default-directory and Desktop local Code records are read-only. Manage Chat, Cowork, SSH and cloud history, and continue Desktop conversations, inside the original client. Tool parameters have depth, item and text limits; attachments do not expand automatically and transcript content renders as text.
- Improved Sub2API usage discovery: identified providers prefer their versioned billing endpoint. OpenAI and Anthropic Messages keys each use their own credentials and balance. Legacy paths, tenant prefixes and missing-endpoint fallback remain supported, with distinct timeout, network / proxy and server-rejection diagnostics.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

v0.13.0 提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP，附带 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。账号、实例、会话和内部存储身份保留。关闭窗口或普通退出会为运行实例保留后台服务；完成任务、退出实例和管理器后再打开新版，以侧栏版本为准。应用内自动更新、Developer ID 签名和公证尚未接入；Windows、Linux 及其他架构尚未验证。

v0.13.0 provides macOS Apple Silicon (arm64) DMG / ZIP packages with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and the internal storage identity are retained. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit preserves background services for active instances. Finish active work and exit the instances and manager before opening the new version; check the sidebar version. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 Claude 订阅 OAuth 与 API Key / Bearer 连接，以及 Claude Desktop 的客户端内登录或 Code / Cowork API / 第三方连接。客户端需单独安装。Claude 会话不提供跨实例复制、导入导出、删除、同步或可见性修复；恢复入口仅用于已停止的受管 CLI 实例。额度查询由供应商计费接口决定，与模型协议独立。

Supported clients include Codex desktop / CLI, the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS with Claude subscription OAuth or API Key / Bearer connections, and Claude Desktop with sign-in inside the client or API / third-party connections for Code / Cowork. Install clients separately. Claude transcripts do not support cross-instance copying, import, export, deletion, synchronization or visibility repair; the resume action applies to stopped managed CLI instances. Usage queries depend on provider billing APIs independently of the model protocol.

## 验证来源 / Verification

回归覆盖会话来源隔离、陈旧和冲突记录拒绝、目录替换、特殊项目路径、只读内容、限载、分页和正文搜索，以及不同密钥额度隔离、租户路径、代理与错误保留。管理器界面使用临时实例和合成记录验证筛选、阅读、恢复预览、取消及启动反馈；真实原生 CLI 使用本机模拟 Messages 服务验证会话解析、原项目续接和跨实例拒绝。已识别 Sub2API 的额度查询另经只读实际请求验证。

本轮不宣称已完成真实账号的 Desktop 登录、Chat / Code / Cowork 或 Claude 订阅模型请求的端到端验收。Desktop 本地 Code 目录和格式与安装的官方客户端契约核对，云端与远程历史保持独立。

Regression checks cover session scope, stale and duplicate records, replaced directories, literal project paths, read-only bounded content, pagination and search, as well as independent key balances, tenant paths, proxies and error retention. Manager UI checks use temporary instances and synthetic transcripts for filtering, reading, resume previews, cancellation and launch feedback. A real native CLI uses a local mock Messages service to verify transcript parsing, resuming the original project and rejecting cross-instance history. Identified Sub2API billing was also verified with a read-only live request.

This release does not claim end-to-end real-account Desktop sign-in, Chat / Code / Cowork or Claude subscription model-request acceptance. Local Desktop Code paths and formats were checked against the installed official client contract; cloud and remote history remain separate.
